posts.author: CEO1234
posts.body:
I want to create an entity that can hit you but not kill you outright. This hit will happen outside of battles as my game will not have any RPG style fights. This was easy enough to do in MV, unless I'm misremembering. You just had to make sure the animation wasn't set to wait for completion. But MZ acts as if it's always perpetually wait for completion and makes it so extreme you can never leave the hit animation when an enemy touches you. I've tried swapping between event pages using switches, but it still freezes the game eternally.
I know you can just swap to player touch which solves the issue, but the player taking control of the situation completely removes the horror element. I want the event to hit you, not for the player to initiate the hit. What to do? I tried looking to see if other people have this problem and surprisingly couldn't find anything, so maybe people are calling it something different or there's something obvious I'm overlooking.

posts.body:
Per the
section guidelines,
please post screenshots of what you're doing in your events.
It's very difficult to give accurate advice just based on anyone's description of what's happening. Both MZ and MV have a Wait for completion check box on the Show Animation event command.

Yes of course I had forgotten about that. Sorry, I will post pictures next time. However, I've already resolved the problem on my own. I just created a separate page to allow swapping between event pages using switches. It didn't work before for reasons I can't remember, but it works fine now. The player is allowed to move after the hit happens.
